summary: Vercel AI SDK + Redwood Hosted API quickstart request (search + chat) for Saffron Circuit Solutions
description:
Customer request originated from self-serve signup + inbound support request (internal ref: RR-4321-POC). Customer is Saffron Circuit Solutions (SMB e-commerce SaaS) running Next.js on Vercel with a Python FastAPI backend + Postgres.

Ask: Provide concrete code snippets and a drop-in example showing Vercel AI SDK + Redwood Hosted API to power (1) site-search (embeddings + reranking) and (2) a conversational help widget.

Requirements (customer language / paraphrase):
- "Want a drop-in example: Vercel AI SDK + Redwood Hosted API to power search/chat."
- Workloads: primary = site-search (embeddings + reranking), secondary = chat assistance for checkout flow.
- Latency targets: search p95 100–300ms for vector lookup; chat first-token <300ms acceptable (streaming).
- Throughput: pilot ~10–20 QPS peak, updated expectation discussed as ~15–30 QPS peak with growth to ~50 QPS in 6 months.
- Cost sensitivity: high; prefer cheaper variants for bulk search queries and higher-quality for chat/help.
- Routing/fallback: want a simple policy-based fallback (primary higher quality; fallback cheaper/quantized where possible).
- Security: public cloud only; audit logging required; customer legal asked about data retention controls for hosted tier.

Updated product guidance since initial request:
- Recommend Vercel AI SDK usage via a Redwood adapter pattern for Edge runtime (fetch + streaming) and a separate Node runtime example for server actions.
- Model guidance updated to current catalog defaults: llama-3.1-8b-instruct as cost-effective chat baseline; llama-3.1-70b-instruct for higher-quality chat; bge-m3 for embeddings; rerank-v3 for reranking (where enabled).
- Clarified that some "quantized" variants are not available on shared hosted tier in all regions; customer should treat the fallback as "cheaper smaller model" rather than guaranteed quantization.

Requested deliverables:
1) TypeScript: Vercel AI SDK streaming chat example calling Redwood Hosted API from an Edge route, including abort/timeout handling and basic retries.
2) Python: LangChain + LlamaIndex example using Redwood Hosted API key (not OpenAI) covering: docs -> embeddings -> vector store (FAISS/Chroma) -> retrieval -> reranking -> simple agent/chat.
3) Cost estimate for a mixed workload (search+chat) at ~30 QPS peak, including batching guidance for embeddings and recommended SLOs/timeouts.

Links referenced by AE/SE:
- Fireflies: ff_20260302_88a3b7
- Gmail: thread-1792kA9pS
- Drive: drive:/redwood/pricing-deck-smb.pdf, drive:/redwood/vercel-quickstart-notes.md

Customer quote from discovery: "We need to show our CTO that this is a 1-day integration for the front-end team — good examples matter."
expected_result: Customer can copy/paste a working Vercel AI SDK + Redwood Hosted API integration for streaming chat and implement an embeddings + reranking search pipeline with Redwood-compatible examples. Customer has enough guidance to estimate cost and choose a simple primary/fallback routing policy.
actual_result: Customer has partial snippets but reported missing a complete, runnable quickstart (Edge streaming + retrieval + reranking) and lacks confidence on cost at target QPS.
impact: Blocks or slows customer POC and affects likelihood of conversion/expansion (hosted_api now, Optimize later).
workaround: Provided interim snippets in email thread (thread-1792kA9pS) and a minimal curl example for streaming until the full quickstart repos are published.
resolution: Not yet resolved. Engineering pairing session completed; remaining action is to finalize README polish + cost estimate and confirm retention/audit-log behavior for hosted tier.
